arguments.query: SELECT (SELECT group_concat(sql, char(10)) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table') AS schemas, service_config.* FROM service_config

SELECT 'booking' AS kind, json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'cancel',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event_id',e.event_id,'step',e.step)) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status!='delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('hold_id',hold_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds

SELECT 'config' AS kind,json_object('service',service,'value',value) AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',e.request_id,'step',e.step) FROM customer_events e LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.request_id=e.request_id UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate',json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'other_booking',o.booking_id,'other_status',o.status) FROM bookings b JOIN bookings o ON b.client_reference=o.client_reference AND b.booking_id<>o.booking_id UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('hold_id',hold_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds

SELECT b.booking_id,b.request_id,b.status,b.client_reference,b.amount_cents, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'amount',c.amount_cents)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id) AS charges, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('kind',e.kind,'step',e.step)) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id) AS customer_events, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',o.booking_id,'status',o.status)) FROM bookings o WHERE o.client_reference=b.client_reference AND o.booking_id<>b.booking_id) AS same_reference FROM bookings b WHERE b.status<>'confirmed'

SELECT 'checks' AS kind,json_object('pending_bookings',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings WHERE status='pending'),'missing_checkins',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN checkins c USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND c.booking_id IS NULL),'confirmed_duplicate_reference',(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING count(*)>1)),'cancelled_holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b JOIN holds h USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='cancelled'),'refunds',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'amount',amount_cents)) FROM refunds)) AS data UNION ALL SELECT 'recent_payment',json_object('path',path,'status',status,'message',message) FROM (SELECT path,status,message FROM request_logs WHERE service='payment' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 8)

SELECT 'booking_check' AS kind,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'status',b.status,'amount',b.amount_cents,'hold_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),'charge_rows',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'amount',c.amount_cents)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'checkin_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM checkins x WHERE x.booking_id=b.booking_id),'refunds',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',r.charge_id,'amount',r.amount_cents)) FROM refunds r WHERE r.booking_id=b.booking_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status<>'confirmed' OR (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured')<>1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins x WHERE x.booking_id=b.booking_id AND x.flight_id=b.flight_id AND x.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) UNION ALL SELECT 'flight_check',json_object('flight',f.flight_id,'capacity',f.capacity,'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)) FROM flights f UNION ALL SELECT 'pending_events',json_object('event_id',event_id,'payload',payload,'status',status) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config

SELECT 'log' AS kind,json_object('service',service,'path',path,'status',status,'message',message,'trace',trace_id) AS data FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs WHERE service='booking' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 12) UNION ALL SELECT 'checkin_error',json_object('path',path,'status',status,'message',message) FROM request_logs WHERE service='checkin' AND status<>200 UNION ALL SELECT 'event_check',json_object('event_id',o.event_id,'booking_id',o.booking_id,'payload',o.payload,'status',o.status,'actual_booking',b.booking_id,'actual_flight',b.flight_id,'actual_passenger',b.passenger_id) FROM outbox o LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=json_extract(o.payload,'$.booking_id') WHERE o.status='quarantined' UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_charge',json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'booking_id',c.booking_id) FROM charges c LEFT JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'wrong_amount',json_object('booking_id',c.booking_id,'charge_amount',c.amount_cents,'booking_amount',b.amount_cents) FROM charges c JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE c.amount_cents<>b.amount_cents

SELECT 'customer_cancel' AS kind,json_object('request_id',e.request_id,'step',e.step,'booking_id',b.booking_id,'status',b.status) AS data FROM customer_events e LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.request_id=e.request_id UNION ALL SELECT 'all_flights',json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'charge_summary',json_object('state',state,'count',count(*)) FROM charges GROUP BY state UNION ALL SELECT 'event_mismatch',json_object('event_id',o.event_id,'booking_id',o.booking_id,'status',o.status,'payload',o.payload) FROM outbox o JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=o.booking_id WHERE o.status='delivered' AND (json_extract(o.payload,'$.booking_id')<>b.booking_id OR json_extract(o.payload,'$.flight_id')<>b.flight_id OR json_extract(o.payload,'$.passenger_id')<>b.passenger_id) UNION ALL SELECT 'recent_bookings',json_object('flight',flight_id,'amount',amount_cents,'count',count(*)) FROM bookings WHERE confirmed_at>=20 GROUP BY flight_id,amount_cents UNION ALL SELECT 'refunded_confirmed',json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id) FROM refunds r JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status<>'cancelled'
